tha-ap461:1.1: Sattipaṇṇiya.] Niharante sarīramhi vajjamānāsu bherisu / pasannacitto sumano sattipuppham apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap461:2.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi dehapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap461:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā sattipaṇṇiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Sattipaṇṇiyattherassa
